description: The plot illustrates the MRR@10 performance of various Dense Passage Retrieval (DPR) methods as a function of the number of queries used during inference. The x-axis is labeled "Number of queries used during inference ($S$)." and features a linear scale ranging from 1 to 10, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "MRR@10" and uses a linear scale ranging from 33.0 to 36.5, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The plot contains several lines representing different methods, most of which include a solid line with circular markers and a corresponding dashed horizontal line. The "DPR w/o query" method is represented by a solid black line with no markers, remaining constant at approximately 34.25 across the entire x-axis. The "DPR w/ curriculum" method features a solid red line with circular markers that starts at approximately 35.15 at x=1, rises to 35.55 at x=2, and gradually increases to end at 35.8 at x=10, accompanied by a dashed red horizontal line constant at 35.6. The "DPR w/ random" method is shown as a solid blue line with circular markers, starting at 34.8 at x=1, rising to a peak of 35.3 at x=3, and ending at 35.3 at x=10, with a dashed blue horizontal line constant at 35.2. The "DPR w/ bottom-1" method is depicted by a solid purple line with circular markers, starting at 34.8 at x=1, peaking at 35.1 at x=3, and gradually declining to 34.7 at x=10, alongside a dashed purple horizontal line constant at 34.9. A green line (whose legend text is obscured by a grey box) with circular markers starts below the y-axis minimum at x=1, rises sharply to 34.7 at x=2, and climbs steadily to reach the highest point on the plot at 36.4 at x=10, paired with a dashed green horizontal line constant at 34.65. Finally, the "DPR w/ gold" method is represented by a solid yellow line with circular markers; it emerges on the plot at approximately 33.0 at x=4 and rises steadily to end at 34.95 at x=10.
